changelog:
- YouTube Shorts Auto-Open Disarmed: Blocked unsolicited client-side SPA redirects to Shorts and restricted autoplay nextVideo strictly to playlists.
- 1-Tap Browser Favorites & Offline Saving: Added dedicated dynamic Favorite Star directly on active browser toolbar and 3-dots sheet.
- Redesigned Cyber Ghost & Pulse Logos: Enlarged touch targets with cyber ghost and cardiogram pulse waveforms.
- Unboxed Live Pulse UI: Completely borderless floating controls for Back, Customize, Country Select, and Weather.
- Unique Editorial News Pictures: Integrated dynamic article photo pool hashing to give each story a distinct picture.
- Fresh 2026 Sports Headlines: Updated feeds for Champions League, Formula 1, NBA, Premier League, IPL, and Grand Slam.
- In-App Visual Studio & Wallpapers: Browse 4K wallpapers and apply directly as startpage background.
- In-App Trending Media & Video Hub: Curated categories and ad-free streaming launcher.
